rules.projection: 640x640 detector letterbox -> 640x480 source; scale=1,padX=0,padY=80; clip to source bounds
rules.realAppearance: yolo: red/blue colorClass takes precedence, otherwise category obstacle
rules.storage: independent source-camera ground pixels; old upright storage/cleanup signs excluded
rules.equality: exact ordered detections, category, bbox, confidence and unchanged source; no tolerance or rounding
rules.expected: active true red/blue/obstacle, camera planar range inclusive 30..85 cm and abs(horizontal bearing)<=30 degrees
rules.detected: for each eligible truth object, at least one bridge detection of its category in that frame
rules.instanceLimitation: Class presence is not instance recall. One output may witness multiple eligible same-class objects; those frames are explicitly listed.
rules.coverage: across the complete suite each of four output classes and each of three eligible truth classes must have a nonzero count
rules.checkpoints: C-ENV-001: exact camera-render checkpoint fields recomputed with time=tick*stepMs/1000; paired fields and RGBA hashes equal
